claim: 'Read-only by construction.' MAC-SETUP.sh's own dry-run output states: "REFUSED here: any 'act click' / 'act type' verb in a generated harness — that is the entire write surface." The cli-anything-connectors skill and CONNECTIONS.md both describe the stack as read-only.
claimSource: MAC-SETUP.sh cli-anything step (dry-run output, 'REFUSED here'); integrations/CONNECTIONS.md CLI-Anything row; .claude/skills/cli-anything-connectors/SKILL.md description
observed: True of the seven site harnesses, false of the engine they all run on. A source sweep for write verbs across every harness found exactly three, all inside the vendored browser engine: browser_cli.py:317 `def act_click`, domshell_backend.py:932 `def click`, :1062 `def type_text`. Executed in a clean venv: `cli-anything-browser act --help` lists 'click  Click an element at the given path' and 'type  Type text into an input element'. There is no ECC gate in the engine — grep for CLI_ANYTHING_ECC_REVIEWED_AT across browser/agent-harness returns nothing — while skyslope and zipforms refuse every live command with exit 3 until it is set. MAC-SETUP.sh symlinks this engine to ~/.local/bin/cli-anything-browser, so the full write surface lands on PATH, ungated, on the Mac that holds the client files.
finding: The read-only guarantee holds for the seven site wrappers and not for the engine binary that MAC-SETUP.sh puts on PATH. P1 has disclosed this accurately in browser/agent-harness/VENDORED.md ('It has an `act` group (`act click`, `act type`) — a real write surface'), so it is documented but not mitigated, and MAC-SETUP.sh's own 'REFUSED here' line still reads as if the write surface is absent.
evidence: Executed in a fresh venv built only from integrations/cli-anything-harnesses/browser/agent-harness: `cli-anything-browser act --help` -> Commands: click, type. `grep -rn 'CLI_ANYTHING_ECC_REVIEWED_AT' browser/agent-harness --include=*.py` -> no matches. Contrast, same run: `cli-anything-skyslope fs ls /` and `page info` and `discover` each exit 3 with 'CLI_ANYTHING_ECC_REVIEWED_AT is not set'; `cli-anything-zipforms fs ls /` exits 3 the same way.
fix: NOT FIXED — P1/P2 own MAC-SETUP.sh and the harness tree and are mid-flight there; reported to the lead instead of edited, to avoid a collision. Suggested: do not symlink cli-anything-browser onto PATH, or wrap it in the same ECC gate the site harnesses use, and reword the MAC-SETUP.sh 'REFUSED here' line so it does not read as a guarantee about the engine.
